$comment: §10.7 referral rate table — the policy the treasury's payer follows. `ref: null` is the default row; a row with a name overrides it for that referrer. `bp` is basis points of the fee in effect at the G's height. The row in effect for (ref, height) is the most specific ref among rows with fromHeight ≤ height, latest fromHeight winning. Append rows with a height; never edit one — a recomputation must reproduce every past share. The app's docs page renders this file.

rates.note: default — 10% of the fee in effect (decided 2026-09-10)
